description:
If you have Severe Back, Butt & Body Acne, this 2.5% bodywash will be your best investment. 

Be Bodywise 2.5% Benzoyl Peroxide Body Wash helps to:

🌟 Reduce Severe Acne: Acne formation happens due to bacteria accumulation. 2.5% Benzoyl Peroxide is known to exfoliate dead skin cells and cleanse pores to remove excess sebum and kill acne-causing bacteria

🌟 Prevent Future Acne: Benzoyl Peroxide is known for its antibacterial properties. It kills acne-causing bacteria, removing present acne and preventing formation

🌟 Deep Cleanse & Moisturize: Enriched with Aloe Vera, Centella Asiatica, and Glycerin, it soothes and moisturizes inflamed skin.

Step 1: On wet skin, take some body wash in your palms or on a loofah.
Step 2: Massage this benzoyl peroxide body wash into skin using a gentle, circular motion.
Step 3: Once done using this body wash containing benzoyl peroxide, rinse.
